purpose.zh: 练大腿后侧和臀部，学会从髋部弯腰而不弓背
purpose.en: Build your hamstrings and glutes and learn to bend from the hips without rounding.

text.zh: 臀部往后推，背保持平直，哑铃贴腿下放
text.en: Push your hips back with a flat back and slide the weights down your legs

text.zh: 膝盖微弯，但不要往下蹲。
text.en: Keep your knees soft without squatting.

text.zh: 哑铃到膝盖下方、大腿后侧有拉伸感就停，再站直。
text.en: Stop just below the knees when the backs of your thighs stretch, then stand tall.

cautions.zh: 从轻重量开始，出现疼痛就停止
cautions.en: Start with a light weight, and stop if you feel pain.

cautions.zh: 腰不舒服时减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: If your lower back feels uncomfortable, reduce the range, and stop if it still hurts.

changes: purpose 去掉「以髋为轴」改口语；cue3 按动画补「哑铃到膝盖下方」
结束口令按 0.8 s 缩为「站直 / Stand tall」
